keyDerivation: seed = SHA-256(UTF-8("1lev1-consent-v1/" + label)); Ed25519 labels "ed25519/<name>", P-256 "p256/<name>", nonces "nonce/<...>" (first 16 bytes)
about: Projection + state root (SPEC_CONSENT_FORMAT §5–§8). Verify every event (§3), fold them in any input order, and reproduce `expect`. `steps[i].rootAfter` is the root after folding applied[0..i] — use it to find the first divergence.

scenarios.name: rikma-lifecycle
scenarios.description: Three members, one of every category-A entity, ties, a merge, a branch, dedupe, redaction, money as strings, an action with no reducer, and a final event that commits to its parent and resulting state roots.

scenarios.name: dedupe-tostring-and-dangling
scenarios.description: order 1 and order "1" are the SAME dedupe key (ECMAScript ToString); a dangling parent is ignored for ordering; equal ts ties break by id. No members, so votes approve only if every recorded vote is yes.

scenarios.name: genesis-snapshot
scenarios.description: T6 migration: a parentless snapshot.commit with upTo:"genesis" carries a normalized state inline; members and balances merge into the fold, the snapshot mark itself stays out of the state root.
